validity.physiological_state: abstract command reception without an actuation effect
validity.description: Checks delivery and storage of a control message at a capable target endpoint.

sources.citation: MEHLISSA Next M6.4 active gateway software contract

limitations: Energy, storage, and count values are synthetic verification values.
Receiving a control message does not release payload or alter a biological model.
Command safety, authentication, and authorization are outside this profile.
